source_clause: R1HS4.1.) When comfort controls are not active, they will be greyed out in the status bar combined temperature/comfort top left/right corners.
reasoning: 驗證目標：11.11.1（R1HS4.1）一句定出 comfort 控制未作用時於狀態列之組合溫度／comfort 角落呈灰，其 037 leaf 即本節自身（無子條）。關鍵情境條件：第十六軸之正向值（17.3）；依 **R-C34**：可觀察量在**狀態列** → 第九軸與第十二軸不補，第十三軸與 EMEA 補。為什麼這樣切：一葉一 TC，其步驟先使控制不作用再讀狀態列；**條文未定義「不作用」之全部情形**（座椅關閉？climate 關閉？），故步驟以「turn the comfort controls off」為之而不列舉其他途徑（§8.4.1）。

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: 狀態列組合溫度／comfort 角落之灰化
interface_axis_review.axis_9: 不暴露 → 不補 —— 可觀察量在**狀態列**，6.3 所移除者為 head unit 之 comfort section
interface_axis_review.axis_12: 不暴露 → 不補 —— 2.1 所移除者為 tabs，狀態列不隨之消失
interface_axis_review.axis_13: 暴露 → 全數補（出處 2.14 C15，跨節取據 R-C29）
interface_axis_review.emea_ics: **排除補並逐條答（R-C36-1）** —— 逐條之答皆為 `no`：ch16 無加熱／通風座椅之行為節（僅 16.16 之座椅 off icon，其 leaf 已停下），見 DR #41 之形態

tcs.tc_title: Inactive comfort controls are greyed out in the status bar
tcs.test_item: The system shall grey out comfort controls in the status bar combined temperature/comfort top left and right corners when they are not active
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with Comfort features, such as heated/vented seats and a heated steering wheel (17.3)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Turn the comfort controls off
2. Read the top left and top right corners of the status bar
tcs.expected_result:
1. The comfort controls are not active
2. The comfort controls are greyed out in the combined temperature/comfort corners
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

emea_ics_review.ch16_sentence: ch16 十八節中僅 `16.16`（ICE15）提及座椅圖示（「Off icon of seats will depend on system configuration」，其 leaf `122-02` 已停下），**無一節定義加熱／通風座椅、加熱方向盤或座椅分區之按壓循環、層級呈現或其 popup**；故本條之 EMEA 排除**無 ch16 對造句可依**，屬 R-C36-1 之過嚴側（同 DR #41 之形態）
